scope: EAS on-chain attestation reconciliation error details

behavior.discrepancy: Provider exceptions are represented by a fixed verification label and bounded exception class; raw RPC/provider messages are not included.
behavior.compatibility: The existing discrepancy issue, request ID, attestation UID, title, verification count, and failure-isolated loop behavior are preserved.

coverage: synthetic provider diagnostic is absent from the reconciliation discrepancy
exceptions from both provider lookup and validity calls are redacted
request and attestation identifiers plus issue classification remain present
exception class is retained in the bounded detail summary

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake connection and mocked EAS client

limitations: No live EAS provider, RPC endpoint, chain, or database was contacted.
This does not establish live attestation validity or capability parity.
